name: Iede Musumegari ~Usotsuki Kami-sama~
original_name: 家出娘狩り～嘘つき神様～
source:
Azusa was a girl with a very short temper. One day she lost it and ran away.
It was poorly planned. With nowhere to go she instantly fell victim to the harsh truths of survival.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088022.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
梓是一個脾氣非常暴躁的女孩。一天她爆發了，離家出走。計畫非常草率。無處可去的她立刻嚐到了獨自在外求生的苦頭。

［來自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088022.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
